verdict.rationale: kitty's first-party remote-control docs say it can be controlled from scripts or the shell prompt to open new windows, send arbitrary text to any window, and change window and tab titles. The CLI is documented at the remote-control page, and the ssh kitten forwards remote-control sockets to remote hosts. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of querying terminal state (e.g. listing windows or tabs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the remote-control interface.
